key_facts.reason_jp: 業績予想を上回る通期業績結果、および株主還元の充実

summary_en: Final dividend for FY5/26 raised to 15 yen/share (10 yen ordinary + 5 yen 30th-anniversary special) from prior forecast of 10 yen/share. Upward earnings revision drove the 5 yen/share increase. Board resolution passed; subject to AGM approval on August 27, 2026.
summary_jp: FY5/26期末配当を15円/株（普通配当10円+記念配当5円）に修正、前回予想10円/株から5円増配。業績上方修正が背景。8月27日の株主総会に付議予定。
tag_en: Dividend hike – FY5/26 final dividend 10 yen/share (ordinary) + 5 yen/share (30th anniversary special), total 15 yen/share vs. prior forecast 10 yen/share
tag_jp: 配当予想修正（増配）– 通常配当10円/株、記念配当5円/株、合計15円/株（前回予想10円/株から増配）
